codeReview.summary: All 7+ item types (Note, Visual, Code, Export, Board, Flashcard Deck, Quiz, Thread, Planner Task) have dedicated glance-tier renderers. Each renderer shows type-specific icon, status indicator, and truncated summary. No generic placeholder cards are used. Glance renderers are cheap (use only pre-loaded ArtifactSummary fields, no per-item content fetch). The bucketArtifacts function correctly categorizes each type into 5 canonical lanes (VISUALS, CODE, STUDY, BOARDS, ARTIFACTS).

summary: Feature w1-c2-glance-renderers passes scrutiny. All 9 item types have dedicated glance-tier preview cards with icon, status dot, and truncated summary. No generic placeholders. No per-item heavy content fetches. bucketArtifacts correctly routes all canonical types. Tests verify lane construction and renderer behavior. TypeScript and full test suite pass. Pre-existing lint issues are unrelated to this feature.
